d:
Namaste, continuing our AGBG series (Automobile Gyaan by Gagan), I now have an interesting video for all those who like to understand cars beyond power figures. The video explains what lies under the chassis/frame of a car. It explains how power flows through the drivetrain and what the key difference is between a 4x4 and AWD. To make it more detailed, I chose one monocoque SUV and the other a ladder-frame SUV.
